title: SCARAB choreographer: safe composable repair orchestrator for first-responder fixlets
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build SCARAB (Safe, Composable, Audit-ready Response Automation Bus): a lightweight choreographer service that composes small, verifiable 'fixlets' (atomic repair steps) into end-to-end repair flows. Goal is to enable first responders to run short, auditable automation during incidents without granting broad privileges or shipping heavy runbooks. SCARAB will provide sandboxing, ephemeral credential injection, step-level rollback (zipper rollback strategy), and a dry-run / approval gate for high-risk flows.
acceptance_criteria: Service can accept a manifest of up to 12 fixlets and execute them in order with transactional rollback semantics
Each fixlet runs in an ephemeral sandbox with credentials provisioned for max 10 minutes and audited via an immutable event hash
Dry-run mode evaluates and validates all fixlets without making production changes and produces a deterministic preview report
RBAC check against SSO groups prevents execution by non-authorized roles; feature-flag gated for beta users
End-to-end telemetry (latency, per-fixlet success/failure, cost estimate) visible in a Grafana dashboard and emitted to existing tracing pipeline
notes: 2025-02-18 - Spike complete: validated approach for ephemeral cred trove using existing KMS wrap/unwrap APIs; prototype executed simple 'restart service' fixlet against staging cluster
2025-02-25 - Architecture decision: adopt existing operator-sidecar sandbox pattern (reuses ENG-531210 sidecar work) to avoid introducing new privileged fleet components
2025-02-28 - Trade-off discussion: considered firecracker isolation but rejected due to cold-start latency; opted for sandbox container + syscall hardening + seccomp profile
2025-03-01 - PR opened for initial choreographer API and CLI shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-scarab/pull/1234 (WIP)
2025-03-02 - Design review notes: PM asked to add customer-safe defaults (auto-timeout 5m, max 3 retries) and to include human-approval step for any action tagged 'high-risk'
Follow-ups: add audit-hash chaining for provenance (see spec), add canary-run flag to limit impact when choreography touches production resources
implementation_plan: Phase 1: implement choreographer API and sandbox runner with dry-run + audit hashing (4w). Phase 2: RBAC integration, KMS ephemeral creds, dashboard instrumentation (3w). Phase 3: canary rollouts for beta teams and doc + runbook migration (2w).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: privileged actions could cause outages if choreography logic is incorrect; Mitigation: require human approval for high-risk tags and implement automatic rollback zipper with containment timeout
Risk: credential leakage from long-running fixlets; Mitigation: enforce 10-minute TTL and one-shot KMS unwrap and ephemeral tokens revoked after execution
Risk: observability gaps; Mitigation: emit structured event per step and require audit-hash written to blobstore before step commit
